questions.q: According to Adler, love helps a person become more self-reliant because it provides what?
questions.why: Adler says opening to love gives strength when needed.

questions.q: Why should educators avoid praising every good deed in a classroom?
questions.why: The text warns praise can form hierarchies and rivalry.

questions.q: What effect does treating children with warmth, empathy, and equality have?
questions.why: Warm, empathetic treatment helps children mature well.

questions.q: How does constant praise affect an adult who is struggling?
a: It may cause embarrassment and discourage trying again
questions.why: The book notes praising a struggling adult can embarrass and hinder future attempts.

questions.q: What is the central claim about childhood trauma in the overview?
a: Most traumas stem from early years
questions.why: The overview states the majority of traumas arise from childhood.
